After analyzing both calendars, I have identified the following common free slots:
- **Monday:** 9:00-9:30, 9:30-10:00
- **Tuesday:** 13:00-13:30, 13:30-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- **Wednesday:** 15:00-15:30, 15:30-16:00
- **Thursday:** 10:00-10:30
- **Friday:** 11:00-11:30, 11:30-12:00

Now that I have this information, I need to communicate it to Brad so he can check the availability of the other two partners. I'll use `append_workspace` to post a clear message for him, listing all the potential meeting times. Then I will end my session to allow Brad to take his turn.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
